backend.plan: CREATE /Users/sydeast/Projects/testai/CascadeProjects/MyTribe/functions/src/admin/setMediaProfilePhoto.ts modeled EXACTLY on admin/rescheduleBooking.ts (onCall + wrapAdminCallable + zod + writeAuditEntry). Zod Args = z.object({ mediaFileId: z.string().min(1).max(120), entityType: z.string().min(1).max(40), entityId: z.string().min(1).max(120) }). Handler: (1) initSentry(); uid guard (rescheduleBooking.ts:33-34). (2) Args.parse with the same ZodError->HttpsError('invalid-argument',{validationErrors}) block. (3) read db().doc(`media_files/${mediaFileId}`); 404 HttpsError('not-found') if absent; read storageUrl + the doc's OWN entityId/entityType as source of truth; HttpsError('failed-precondition') if they do not match the args (prevents cross-entity flips). (4) WriteBatch: query media_files where entityId==entityId AND entityType==entityType AND isProfilePhoto==true, set isProfilePhoto=false on each sibling != chosen; set isProfilePhoto=true on the chosen doc. (5) Stamp the entity photo field IN THE SAME BATCH, normalizing entityType to upper-case: 'KINFOLK' -> batch.set(db().doc(`kinfolk/${entityId}`), {profilePictureUrl: storageUrl, updatedAt: serverTimestamp()}, {merge:true}); 'KIN' -> `kin/${entityId}` {profilePictureUrl}; 'USER' -> `users/${entityId}` {photoUrl, updatedAt}; any other entityType -> only flip the media flag, NO entity write (no fabricated target). Use storageUrl (full asset, matches AdminSettingsViewModel photoUrl=mediaFile.storageUrl), not thumbnailUrl. batch.commit(). (6) writeAuditEntry({ event: AUDIT_EVENTS.PROFILE_UPDATED, severity:'info', actorRole:'AUNTIE', actorUid:uid, payload:{ mediaFileId, entityType, entityId, photoUrl: storageUrl } }). (7) logEvent. (8) return { ok:true, mediaFileId, entityId, photoUrl: storageUrl }. Runs as admin via wrapAdminCallable (admin SDK bypasses rules) so no client-rule change. This is the FIRST media callable; the flag-flip MUST be the callable because the atomic sibling-clear + entity stamp cannot be a safe client batch.

risks: 1) Entity-type casing drift: web passes lowercase 'kinfolk' (App.kt:284) while Android passes enum .name 'KINFOLK'; the callable MUST upper-case before branching or it silently no-ops the entity write. Cover with a test for both casings. 2) The entity field differs by type (kinfolk/kin use profilePictureUrl, user uses photoUrl); the USER branch must write photoUrl to match what AdminSettingsViewModel/ProfilePanel read, else a phantom field. 3) Web media docs are written client-side today (not via callable), so this is the first server write to media_files from web; ensure the admin custom claim holds for the sole admin (it does). 4) Re-enabling FeatureFlags.settingsProfilePicUpload default true must wait until the web picker leg is verified, else the spec-28 'no no-op button' rule is violated. 5) Stamp storageUrl (full asset) not thumbnailUrl onto the entity, matching Android's existing photoUrl=mediaFile.storageUrl, so avatars are not low-res thumbnails.
